newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares end lower on profit taking.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares end lower on profit taking.

text.p: 1635 GMT - Portuguese shares and futures on the PSI20 .PSI20 index of 20 leading stocks and on Portugal Telecom ended lower on profit taking, in tune with international markets. Total turnover was 23.1 billion escudos, 50 percent of which was accounted for by trade in recently privatised utility EDP-Electricidade de Portugal, cement group Semapa and Portugal Telecom. Dealers said investors squared positions in Semapa and PT to coincide with the end of the first half of 1997. Some investors took advantage of the negative mood on international markets to take profits amid nervousness ahead of this week's Fed meeting.
